answer: Like an ocean tide filtering grains of sand, trust crystallizes across a decentralized consensus graph. An untrusted agent begins isolated on a barren island; to participate, it must extend a cryptographic jetty into verified peer clusters. Sybil swarms attempting to fabricate a fake consensus haven face superlinear staking and proof-of-work penalties that scale exponentially with cluster density, drowning forged identities in prohibitive economic drag.
